channel.title: Warhammer 40k Community RSS Feed
channel.description: Latest intelligence reports from the Warhammer Community

item.title: Sunday Preview – The galaxy calls, and Krieg answers
item.description: The article previews upcoming Warhammer releases, highlighting new models and updates for the Krieg faction, showcasing their readiness to respond to galactic conflicts.

item.title: This year’s Warhammer event miniatures revealed
item.description: The Warhammer article announces the unveiling of new event-exclusive miniatures for this year's Warhammer events, showcasing unique designs and characters that fans can collect.

item.title: Astartes II Teaser Trailer – Watch it right now
item.description: The article announces and invites viewers to watch the teaser trailer for "Astartes II," a fan-made sequel project set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe, showcasing impressive visuals and promising an intense continuation of its predecessor's narrative.

item.title: Trench Grime on Krieg Artillery with Contrast paints | Warhammer 40,000
item.description: This Warhammer Community video tutorial demonstrates how to effectively use Contrast paints to achieve a realistic trench grime effect on Krieg artillery models for Warhammer 40,000.

item.title: Astartes II – Official Teaser Trailer | Warhammer+
item.description: The official teaser trailer for "Astartes II" on Warhammer+ showcases intense, visually striking sequences that promise to further explore the dark, gritty universe of Warhammer 40,000 through the eyes of the enigmatic Space Marines.

item.title: New Phoenix Lords with Contrast! | Warhammer 40,000
item.description: The article introduces new Phoenix Lords models for Warhammer 40,000, highlighted by their vivid detailing using Contrast paints to enhance their appearance.

item.title: Warhammer Studio Interview – Designing the new Phoenix Lords and Aspect Warriors
item.description: The article features an interview with the Warhammer Studio team, discussing their creative process and the intricate details involved in redesigning the new Phoenix Lords and Aspect Warriors for enhanced visual impact and game functionality.

item.title: Phoenix Lords and Aspect Warriors painted by the wider Warhammer Hobby Community
item.description: The article showcases a vibrant gallery of Phoenix Lords and Aspect Warriors, each uniquely painted by talented members of the Warhammer hobby community.

item.title: Aeldari Corsair showcase: The Ballad of the Sky Serpents
item.description: The article showcases the Aeldari Corsairs known as the Sky Serpents, highlighting their lore, vibrant miniature designs, and the creativity behind their thematic army in the Warhammer universe.

item.title: How to use the Ynnari and Harlequins in the new Codex: Aeldari
item.description: The article provides strategies and unit recommendations for effectively using the Ynnari and Harlequins within the new Codex: Aeldari to enhance gameplay dynamics in Warhammer 40K.

item.title: Codex: Aeldari masters combat with eight powerful Detachments to choose from
item.description: The article discusses how the new Codex: Aeldari enhances gameplay by offering eight diverse and powerful Detachments, each tailored to different strategic approaches in Warhammer 40,000.

item.title: Who are the Phoenix Lords? The legendary Aeldari heroes explained
item.description: The Phoenix Lords are the immortal and legendary heroes of the Aeldari, each embodying the pinnacle of the Aspect Warrior path, serving as both leaders in battle and spiritual exemplars for their race.
